Serbia matches on the procedural duty, the exchange system and the ex officio problem. Commission wording on fragmented responsibilities (SRB-EU-2025-001-0008) is in the unmatched queue and is not relied on.

Montenegro matches North Macedonia on stated institutional obstacles (MKD-GOV-2025-004-0065), and on a platform where access and active exchange are counted (MKD-GOV-2025-004-0186, MKD-EU-2023-003-0040). Commission wording on once-only has no match on the North Macedonian side, where the term appears only in the country's own screening presentation (MKD-EU-2023-003-0029), although its Reform Agenda says institutions do not gather evidence ex officio (MKD-GOV-2024-001-0097). It differs in a smaller count of institutions, a platform reported as under development in 2025 and established in 2026, no evidence of underuse by connected institutions, and resources appearing through staffing of the inspection, not IT staff in institutions.
